SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS max_free_rate_ages_5_17
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE s.numtsttakr > 0
  AND s.numge1500::float / s.numtsttakr > 0.3

SELECT s.mailstreet, s.school
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE sat.avgscrmath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.avgscrmath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

WITH locally_funded_diffs AS (
  SELECT s.school,
         s.doctype,
         f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment_diff
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
  WHERE s.fundingtype = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT school, doctype
FROM locally_funded_diffs
WHERE enrollment_diff > (SELECT AVG(enrollment_diff) FROM locally_funded_diffs)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN county = 'Orange' AND doctype = 'Unified School District' AND statustype = 'Merged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN doctype = 'Elementary School District' AND statustype = 'Merged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools

SELECT ROUND(CAST(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS numeric), 6) AS "K-12 eligible meal rate"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.soc = '66'
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*) AS non_charter_la_schools_below_0_18_pct
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
  AND "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" < 0.0018

SELECT T1."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)",
       T1."District Code"
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
    ON T1.cdscode = T2.cdscode
WHERE T2.admfname1 = 'Alusine'
   OR T2.admfname2 = 'Alusine'
   OR T2.admfname3 = 'Alusine'

SELECT
    "School Name",
    100.0 * "FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" / NULLIF("Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0) AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Low Grade" = 'K'
  AND "High Grade" = '9'

SELECT DISTINCT email
FROM (
    SELECT admemail1 AS email
    FROM schools
    WHERE soctype = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)'
      AND city = 'San Bernardino'
      AND county = 'San Bernardino'
      AND doctype = 'Unified School District'
      AND opendate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
    UNION
    SELECT admemail2 AS email
    FROM schools
    WHERE soctype = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)'
      AND city = 'San Bernardino'
      AND county = 'San Bernardino'
      AND doctype = 'Unified School District'
      AND opendate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
    UNION
    SELECT admemail3 AS email
    FROM schools
    WHERE soctype = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)'
      AND city = 'San Bernardino'
      AND county = 'San Bernardino'
      AND doctype = 'Unified School District'
      AND opendate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
) AS admin_emails
WHERE email IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(s.numtsttakr, 0))::numeric, 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers
FROM schools sc
LEFT JOIN satscores s
  ON s.cds = sc.cdscode
WHERE sc.charternum = '0756'
  AND sc.mailcity = 'San Diego'

WITH target AS (
    SELECT s.ncesschool,
           f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS enrollment_5_17
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.cdscode IN ('01751010130583', '01612910137588', '01611760134270')
)
SELECT DISTINCT ncesschool
FROM target
WHERE enrollment_5_17 = (SELECT MAX(enrollment_5_17) FROM target)

WITH base AS (
    SELECT s.school,
           s.gsserved,
           split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 1) AS low_grade
    FROM schools s
    LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.ncesdist = '0613360'
      AND s.statustype = 'Active'
      AND split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 2) = '12'
      AND (sat.numtsttakr IS NULL OR sat.numtsttakr = 0)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT school,
           gsserved,
           CASE
               WHEN low_grade IN ('PS', 'PK') THEN -2
               WHEN low_grade = 'TK' THEN -1
               WHEN low_grade = 'K' THEN 0
               WHEN low_grade ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN low_grade::int
           END AS start_rank
    FROM base
)
SELECT school AS "School Name",
       gsserved AS "Grade Span Served"
FROM ranked
WHERE start_rank = (SELECT MIN(start_rank) FROM ranked)
ORDER BY school

WITH state_schools AS (
  SELECT sc.school, sc.mailstreet, sat.avgscrread
  FROM schools sc
  JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = sc.cdscode
  WHERE sc.doctype = 'State Special Schools'
    AND sat.rtype = 'S'
)
SELECT school, mailstreet
FROM state_schools
WHERE avgscrread = (SELECT MAX(avgscrread) FROM state_schools)

SELECT DISTINCT s.city
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.cdscode = '01611920113902'
  AND s.county = 'Alameda'
  AND s.eilcode = 'HS'
  AND f."Low Grade" = '9'
  AND f."High Grade" = '12'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2'

SELECT s.avgscrmath, s.numtsttakr
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.cdscode
WHERE s.cds = '01611190130609'
  AND sc.fundingtype = 'Directly funded'

WITH sb_sat AS (
  SELECT s.school, s.phone, sat.numge1500
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
  WHERE s.doctype = 'Statewide Benefit Charters'
)
SELECT school, phone
FROM sb_sat
WHERE numge1500 = (SELECT MAX(numge1500) FROM sb_sat)

SELECT DISTINCT s.school, s.city
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.eilcode = 'HS'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
  AND split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 1) ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 1)::int > 9
ORDER BY s.school

WITH target AS (
  SELECT numtsttakr
  FROM satscores
  WHERE cds = '07618040730051'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM satscores s
CROSS JOIN target t
WHERE s.cname = 'Contra Costa'
  AND s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.numtsttakr > t.numtsttakr

SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat
  ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.mailcity = 'San Francisco'
  AND s.doctype IN (
        'Unified School District',
        'High School District',
        'Elementary School District',
        'County Office of Education (COE)'
  )
  AND (sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite) >= 1500

SELECT split_part(gsserved, '-', 1) AS lowest_grade
FROM schools
WHERE ncesdist = '0632640'
  AND split_part(gsserved, '-', 1) ~ '^(K|[0-9]+)$'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN split_part(gsserved, '-', 1) = 'K' THEN 0
              ELSE CAST(split_part(gsserved, '-', 1) AS INTEGER) END
LIMIT 1

SELECT school, eilname
FROM schools
WHERE cdscode = '1612590136051'

SELECT ROUND(
         COALESCE(SUM(f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"), 0)::numeric
         / COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode),
       2) AS avg_frpm_count_ages_5_17
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f
       ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
      AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
WHERE s.soctype LIKE '%Youth Authority%'

WITH sb_schools AS (
    SELECT sat.sname, s.admemail1, sat.numge1500
    FROM satscores sat
    JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.doctype = 'State Board of Education'
      AND sat.rtype = 'S'
)
SELECT sname, admemail1
FROM sb_schools
WHERE numge1500 = (SELECT MAX(numge1500) FROM sb_schools)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(sat.numtsttakr, 0))::numeric, 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN satscores sat
  ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.county = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.opendate >= DATE '2007-01-01'
  AND s.opendate <  DATE '2008-01-01'
  AND s.doctype IN (
        'Unified School District',
        'Elementary School District',
        'High School District',
        'County Office of Education (COE)'
      )

WITH public_schools AS (
    SELECT cdscode, district, admfname1, admfname2, admfname3
    FROM schools
    WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND doctype IN ('Unified School District',
                      'Elementary School District',
                      'High School District',
                      'County Office of Education (COE)')
),
admin_names AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cdscode, district, admfname1 AS fname
    FROM public_schools
    WHERE admfname1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT cdscode, district, admfname2 AS fname
    FROM public_schools
    WHERE admfname2 IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT cdscode, district, admfname3 AS fname
    FROM public_schools
    WHERE admfname3 IS NOT NULL
),
top_names AS (
    SELECT fname
    FROM (
        SELECT fname, COUNT(DISTINCT cdscode) AS num_schools
        FROM admin_names
        GROUP BY fname
    ) ranked
    ORDER BY num_schools DESC, fname ASC
    LIMIT 2
),
districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT district
    FROM public_schools
    WHERE district IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.district AS district_name,
       n.fname AS first_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.cdscode) AS num_schools
FROM districts d
CROSS JOIN top_names n
LEFT JOIN admin_names a
       ON a.district = d.district
      AND a.fname = n.fname
GROUP BY d.district, n.fname
ORDER BY d.district, n.fname

WITH middle_schools AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        f."School Type",
        f."School Name",
        s.latitude
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
    WHERE f."School Type" = 'Intermediate/Middle Schools (Public)'
       OR f."School Name" ILIKE '%Middle%'
)
SELECT "School Type", "School Name", latitude
FROM middle_schools
WHERE latitude = (SELECT MAX(latitude) FROM middle_schools)

SELECT
    s.fundingtype AS funding_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS active_charter_schools,
    SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_enrollment_2014_2015,
    ROUND((AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") * 100)::numeric, 2) AS avg_frpm_eligible_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite)::numeric, 2) AS avg_combined_sat
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f
    ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
   AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
LEFT JOIN satscores sat
    ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.charter = 1
  AND s.statustype = 'Active'
  AND s.fundingtype IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY s.fundingtype

SELECT f."School Name",
       f."Low Grade" AS earliest_grade,
       f."Enrollment (K-12)",
       COALESCE(s.numtsttakr, 0) AS sat_test_takers
FROM frpm f
LEFT JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE f."District Type" = 'State Special Schools'
  AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
ORDER BY CASE
           WHEN f."Low Grade" = 'P' THEN -1
           WHEN f."Low Grade" = 'K' THEN 0
           ELSE CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER)
         END DESC,
         f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST,
         f."School Name" ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.cdscode) AS school_count
FROM frpm f
LEFT JOIN satscores s
  ON s.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500
  AND f."High Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND CAST(f."High Grade" AS INTEGER) <= 8
  AND f."School Code" <> '0000000'
  AND NULLIF(TRIM(f."School Name"), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(s.numtsttakr, 0) = 0

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT s.school,
           s.district,
           s.county,
           sat.avgscrwrite
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.statustype = 'Closed'
      AND sat.avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL
),
runner_up AS (
    SELECT MAX(avgscrwrite) AS score
    FROM filtered
    WHERE avgscrwrite < (SELECT MAX(avgscrwrite) FROM filtered)
)
SELECT f.school,
       f.district,
       f.county,
       f.avgscrwrite
FROM filtered f
JOIN runner_up r ON f.avgscrwrite = r.score

SELECT s.fundingtype AS "Charter Funding Type",
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS "Active School Count",
       SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS "Total K-12 Enrollment",
       SUM(f."FRPM Count (K-12)") AS "Total FRPM-Eligible K-12 Students"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.doctype = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
  AND s.charter = 1
  AND s.statustype = 'Active'
  AND s.fundingtype IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY s.fundingtype
ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.fundingtype = 'Directly funded' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / 12 AS avg_schools_per_month
FROM schools
WHERE county = 'San Diego'
  AND opendate >= DATE '1980-01-01'
  AND opendate < DATE '1981-01-01'
  AND doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District', 'High School District')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS schools_with_zero_sat_test_takers
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.statustype = 'Active'
  AND s.eilname = 'High School'
  AND COALESCE(sat.numtsttakr, 0) = 0

SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN s.virtual IN ('F', 'P') THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*),
         1
       ) AS virtual_percentage
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE sat.avgscrmath > 400

SELECT
  s.school AS school_name,
  s.county,
  s.district,
  s.city,
  f."Enrollment (K-12)",
  f."FRPM Count (K-12)",
  f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
  sat.numtsttakr,
  sat.avgscrread,
  sat.avgscrmath,
  sat.avgscrwrite,
  sat.numge1500
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f
  ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat
  ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.cdscode = LPAD('1612590137943', 14, '0')

WITH target_county AS (
  SELECT county
  FROM schools
  WHERE cdscode = '01100170109835'
),
counties AS (
  SELECT 'Santa Barbara' AS county
  UNION
  SELECT county FROM target_county
)
SELECT c.county AS county_name,
       COUNT(s.cdscode) AS exclusive_virtual_count
FROM counties c
LEFT JOIN schools s
       ON s.county = c.county
      AND s.virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY c.county
ORDER BY exclusive_virtual_count DESC, county_name ASC

WITH target AS (
    SELECT f."County Name" AS county_name
    FROM frpm f
    WHERE f.cdscode = LPAD('1612590125716', 14, '0')
    LIMIT 1
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        f.cdscode,
        f."County Name" AS county_name,
        ROUND((f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS free_pct,
        ROUND((f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS frpm_pct,
        f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter_flag
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN target t ON f."County Name" = t.county_name
    WHERE f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500
      AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
)
SELECT
    b.county_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
    ROUND(AVG(b.free_pct), 2) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(b.frpm_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.charter_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_charter_schools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.charter_flag = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_non_charter_schools,
    ROUND(AVG(s.avgscrread + s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrwrite)::numeric, 2) AS avg_sat_total
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = b.cdscode
GROUP BY b.county_name

WITH target AS (
  SELECT s.school,
         s.phone,
         s.website,
         s.charter,
         sat.avgscrread,
         sat.avgscrmath,
         sat.avgscrwrite
  FROM schools s
  LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
  WHERE s.cdscode = '7618040113118'
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT MAX(sat.avgscrmath) AS max_math
  FROM satscores sat
  JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = sat.cds
  WHERE s.statustype = 'Active'
    AND sat.numtsttakr >= 10
)
SELECT t.school AS school_name,
       t.phone,
       t.website,
       t.avgscrread,
       t.avgscrmath,
       t.avgscrwrite,
       t.charter,
       f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12_2014_2015,
       ROUND((f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100)::numeric, 2) AS pct_frpm_eligible,
       b.max_math AS highest_active_school_avg_math,
       b.max_math - t.avgscrmath AS math_gap_from_highest
FROM target t
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
LEFT JOIN frpm f
       ON f.cdscode = '7618040113118'
      AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'

WITH virtual_schools AS (
    SELECT s.cdscode, s.county, s.school, sat.avgscrread
    FROM schools s
    LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.virtual = 'F'
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS virtual_count
    FROM virtual_schools
    GROUP BY county
),
top_counties AS (
    SELECT county, virtual_count
    FROM (
        SELECT county, virtual_count,
               RANK() OVER (ORDER BY virtual_count DESC) AS county_rank
        FROM county_counts
    ) ranked
    WHERE county_rank <= 5
),
best_schools AS (
    SELECT county, school
    FROM (
        SELECT county, school,
               RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY avgscrread DESC) AS school_rank
        FROM virtual_schools
        WHERE avgscrread IS NOT NULL
    ) ranked_schools
    WHERE school_rank = 1
)
SELECT tc.county AS "County Name",
       tc.virtual_count AS "Exclusively Virtual Schools",
       COALESCE(bs.school, 'None') AS "School Name"
FROM top_counties tc
LEFT JOIN best_schools bs ON bs.county = tc.county
ORDER BY tc.virtual_count DESC, tc.county, bs.school

WITH frpm_agg AS (
  SELECT f.cdscode,
         SUM(f."Free Meal Count (K-12)") AS free_cnt,
         SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)")      AS enroll_cnt
  FROM frpm f
  GROUP BY f.cdscode
),
cand AS (
  SELECT s.school,
         s.charter,
         s.gsserved,
         (a.free_cnt / a.enroll_cnt)::numeric AS free_rate,
         (sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite) AS sat_total
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm_agg a       ON a.cdscode = s.cdscode
  LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
  WHERE s.county = 'Alameda'
    AND split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 2) = '12'
    AND a.enroll_cnt > 0
)
SELECT school AS "School Name",
       ROUND(free_rate, 4) AS "Free Meal Rate",
       CASE WHEN charter = 1 THEN 'Yes'
            WHEN charter = 0 THEN 'No'
            ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Charter School",
       gsserved AS "Grades Served",
       CASE WHEN sat_total IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
            WHEN sat_total < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
            WHEN sat_total <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
            ELSE 'Above Average' END AS "SAT Performance Level"
FROM cand
WHERE free_rate = (SELECT MAX(free_rate) FROM cand)

SELECT s.school, s.street
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30
  AND (CASE WHEN f."Low Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(f."Low Grade" AS integer) END) >= 9
ORDER BY s.cdscode ASC

SELECT s.school, s.street
FROM schools s
WHERE s.school IS NOT NULL
  AND s.school <> ''
  AND s.cdscode IN (
      SELECT f.cdscode
      FROM frpm f
      WHERE (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30
        AND (
              f."High Grade" = 'K'
           OR (f."High Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(f."High Grade" AS integer) <= 8)
            )
  )

SELECT f."County Name" AS county,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.cdscode) AS qualifying_schools
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s
  ON s.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.numge1500 >= 1
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1
  AND f."County Name" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY f."County Name"
ORDER BY qualifying_schools DESC, county ASC

WITH target AS (
    SELECT county
    FROM schools
    WHERE cdscode = LPAD('1611430131177', 14, '0')
)
SELECT s.admfname1, s.admlname1
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.county = (SELECT county FROM target)
ORDER BY sat.numge1500 DESC NULLS LAST, sat.cds ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.city,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS magnet_provision2_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f
  ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.magnet = 1
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
GROUP BY s.city

SELECT s.street, s.city, s.zip, s.state
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.numtsttakr >= 700
ORDER BY (sat.numge1500::numeric / sat.numtsttakr) ASC,
         CAST(RIGHT(sat.cds, 7) AS bigint) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT id
FROM cards
WHERE bordercolor = 'borderless'
  AND (cardkingdomid IS NULL OR cardkingdomfoilid IS NULL)

WITH ruling_counts AS (
  SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM rulings
  GROUP BY uuid
),
max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(cnt) AS mx
  FROM ruling_counts
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.name, c.artist, c.ispromo
FROM cards c
JOIN ruling_counts rc ON c.uuid = rc.uuid
WHERE rc.cnt = (SELECT mx FROM max_count)

SELECT s.school AS school_name,
       s.street,
       s.city,
       s.state,
       s.zip
FROM schools s
WHERE s.cdscode IN (
    SELECT f.cdscode
    FROM frpm f
    WHERE f."County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
      AND f."School Type" IN (
            'High Schools (Public)',
            'Continuation High Schools (Public)',
            'High Schools in 1 School District (Public)'
          )
      AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 500
)
ORDER BY s.school
SELECT DISTINCT text FROM cards WHERE name = 'Benalish Knight'

WITH provision2_magnet AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.cdscode, s.county
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
  WHERE f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
    AND s.magnet = 1
)
SELECT p.county AS "County Name",
       COALESCE(SUM(sat.numtsttakr), 0) AS "Total SAT Test Takers"
FROM provision2_magnet p
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = p.cdscode
GROUP BY p.county

SELECT ROUND(
         CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN id END) AS REAL) * 100
         / COUNT(id),
         2) AS percentage
FROM foreign_data

SELECT ta.buildupplaydribblingclass

WITH home_wins AS (

win_counts AS (

SELECT t.team_long_name,

SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.total_goals)::numeric, 2) AS avg_home_goals_per_player

WITH latest_ratings AS (

WITH heavy_appearances AS (

country_counts AS (

ranked AS (

SELECT country_name, cnt

WITH lineup AS (

SELECT l.season,

WITH match_players AS (

light_players AS (

country_counts AS (

WHERE cnt = (SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM country_counts)

WITH latest AS (

WITH latest AS (

current_left AS (

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count

WITH lineup AS (

WITH cercle AS (

last_match AS (

donovan AS (

population AS (

WITH loan_account AS (

daily_balance AS (

SELECT a.frequency, o.k_symbol

JOIN "order" o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = 3

WITH male_loans AS (

yearly AS (

)
SELECT (MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 1997 THEN total_amount END)

SELECT COUNT(*)

WITH first_month AS (

first_month_districts AS (

SELECT region, total

WITH serving_districts AS (

    FROM client c

    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id

SELECT

WITH owner_accounts AS (

loan_counts AS (

SELECT ROUND(AVG(loan_count), 2)

WITH top5 AS (

),
acc_counts AS (

active_loans AS (

WITH qualifying_accounts AS (

    WHERE CAST(d.a4 AS bigint) >= 250000
      AND EXISTS (

totals AS (

WITH prachatice AS (
  SELECT district_id
  FROM district
  WHERE a2 = 'Prachatice'
),
borrowing_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opening_date
  FROM account a
  JOIN prachatice p ON a.district_id = p.district_id
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id)
),
borrowed AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed
  FROM loan l
  GROUP BY l.account_id
),
counterparties AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.account) AS counterparty_count
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')
    AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    AND t.account <> 0
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
owners AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, c.district_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
result AS (
  SELECT
    ba.account_id,
    ba.opening_date,
    b.total_borrowed,
    COALESCE(cp.counterparty_count, 0) AS counterparty_count,
    o.district_id AS home_district_id,
    CAST(hd.a4 AS bigint) AS district_population
  FROM borrowing_accounts ba
  JOIN borrowed b ON b.account_id = ba.account_id
  LEFT JOIN counterparties cp ON cp.account_id = ba.account_id
  JOIN owners o ON o.account_id = ba.account_id
  JOIN district hd ON hd.district_id = o.district_id
)
SELECT
  account_id,
  opening_date,
  total_borrowed,
  counterparty_count,
  home_district_id,
  district_population,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY district_population DESC) AS population_rank
FROM result
ORDER BY district_population DESC, account_id ASC

WITH card_districts AS (

),
min_per_type AS (
    SELECT card_type, MIN(inhabitants) AS min_inhabitants

)
SELECT DISTINCT cd.card_type, cd.district_id, cd.inhabitants
FROM card_districts cd
JOIN min_per_type m

 AND cd.inhabitants = m.min_inhabitants

WITH qualifying AS (

  JOIN disp d
    ON d.client_id = c.client_id
   AND d.type = 'OWNER'

q AS (

),
top_district AS (

)
SELECT q.region,
       ROUND(AVG(q.avg_salary)::numeric, 2) AS avg_district_salary,
       ROUND(AVG(q.unemp_1996)::numeric, 2) AS avg_unemployment_rate_1996,
       t.district_name AS most_populous_district
FROM q
JOIN top_district t ON t.region = q.region

WITH gold_holders AS (

    JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN disp o ON o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = o.client_id
    WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
),
high_bal AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
    HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000
),
gd AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT g.gender, g.district_id
    FROM gold_holders g
    WHERE g.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM high_bal)
),
big AS (
    SELECT gd.gender,
           ds.district_id,
           ds.a2,
           ds.a4::bigint AS inhabitants,
           ds.a10::numeric AS urban_ratio,
           ds.a11::numeric AS salary
    FROM gd
    JOIN district ds ON ds.district_id = gd.district_id
    WHERE ds.a4::bigint > 100000
),
stats AS (
    SELECT gender,
           COUNT(*) AS n,
           ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
           ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio), 2) AS avg_urban
    FROM big
    GROUP BY gender
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT b.*,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.gender ORDER BY b.inhabitants DESC) AS rk
    FROM big b
)
SELECT r.gender,
       s.n AS num_districts,
       r.a2 AS district,
       r.inhabitants,
       s.avg_salary,
       s.avg_urban
FROM ranked r
JOIN stats s ON s.gender = r.gender
WHERE r.rk = 1
ORDER BY CASE r.gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END, r.a2

WITH top3 AS (
    SELECT
        a2 AS district_name,
        a16 AS crimes_1996,
        a4::bigint AS inhabitants,
        translate(a2,
            'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýžÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽ',
            'acdeeinorstuuyzACDEEINORSTUUYZ') AS name_sort_key
    FROM district
    WHERE a3 = 'central Bohemia'
    ORDER BY a4::bigint DESC,
             translate(a2,
                 'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýžÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽ',
                 'acdeeinorstuuyzACDEEINORSTUUYZ') ASC
    LIMIT 3
),
top3_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(crimes_1996) AS avg_top3
    FROM top3
),
all_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(a16) AS avg_all
    FROM district
)
SELECT
    t.district_name,
    t.crimes_1996,
    ROUND(ta.avg_top3::numeric, 2) AS three_district_avg_crimes_1996,
    ROUND(aa.avg_all::numeric, 2) AS overall_avg_crimes_1996,
    ROUND((ta.avg_top3 - aa.avg_all)::numeric, 2) AS difference
FROM top3 t
CROSS JOIN top3_avg ta
CROSS JOIN all_avg aa
ORDER BY t.inhabitants DESC,
         t.name_sort_key ASC

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.amount,
        a.district_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.loan_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
top_loans AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM ranked_loans
    WHERE rn <= 10
),
loan_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.district_id,
        CAST(d.a4 AS bigint) AS inhabitants,
        d.a11 AS avg_salary
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM top_loans)
)
SELECT
    ld.district_id,
    ld.inhabitants,
    ROUND((SELECT AVG(avg_salary) FROM loan_districts)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary
FROM loan_districts ld
ORDER BY ld.inhabitants DESC, ld.district_id ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH district_pop AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        a2 AS district_name,
        a3 AS region,
        CAST(a4 AS bigint) AS population
    FROM district
    WHERE CAST(a4 AS bigint) >= 100000
),
withdrawals AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        SUM(t.amount::numeric) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
standing AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        SUM(o.amount::numeric) AS so_total
    FROM "order" o
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
accts AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        COUNT(*) AS n_accounts
    FROM account
    GROUP BY district_id
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        dp.district_name,
        dp.region,
        dp.population,
        w.total_withdrawn,
        ROUND(w.total_withdrawn / dp.population, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
        ROUND(COALESCE(s.so_total, 0) / ac.n_accounts, 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit
    FROM district_pop dp
    JOIN withdrawals w ON w.district_id = dp.district_id
    JOIN accts ac ON ac.district_id = dp.district_id
    LEFT JOIN standing s ON s.district_id = dp.district_id
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    region,
    population,
    total_withdrawn,
    withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS rank,
    avg_standing_order_debit
FROM base
ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC

WITH acc AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           a.district_id,
           TO_CHAR(a.date, 'YYYY') AS yr,
           COALESCE(l.total_amount, 0) AS lent
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d
      ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
        FROM loan
        GROUP BY account_id
    ) l
      ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE d.a3 = 'central Bohemia'
      AND a.date >= DATE '1996-01-01'
),
dist AS (
    SELECT yr,
           district_id,
           COUNT(*) AS n,
           SUM(lent) AS lent_sum
    FROM acc
    GROUP BY yr, district_id
)
SELECT yr AS year,
       SUM(n) AS account_count,
       SUM(lent_sum) AS total_lent,
       ROUND(AVG(lent_sum::numeric / n), 2) AS avg_lent_per_account
FROM dist
GROUP BY yr
ORDER BY yr

WITH top_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id,
           l.account_id,
           l.amount,
           l.date,
           a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
    ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.date ASC, l.loan_id ASC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT t.district_id,
       t.amount,
       t.date,
       tr.balance
FROM top_loans t
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT tx.balance
    FROM trans tx
    WHERE tx.account_id = t.account_id
      AND tx.date <= t.date
    ORDER BY tx.date DESC, tx.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
) tr ON TRUE
ORDER BY t.amount DESC, t.date ASC, t.loan_id ASC

WITH target_region AS (
  SELECT a3 AS region
  FROM district
  WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'
),
region_districts AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.a2
  FROM district d
  WHERE d.a3 = (SELECT region FROM target_region)
),
new_accts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN region_districts rd ON rd.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE a.date BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31'
),
last_tx AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.account_id) t.account_id, t.balance
  FROM trans t
  JOIN new_accts n ON n.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
  ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
),
acct_bal AS (
  SELECT n.account_id, n.district_id, l.balance
  FROM new_accts n
  LEFT JOIN last_tx l ON l.account_id = n.account_id
),
dist_stats AS (
  SELECT rd.district_id,
         rd.a2 AS district_name,
         COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened,
         AVG(b.balance) AS avg_raw
  FROM acct_bal b
  JOIN region_districts rd ON rd.district_id = b.district_id
  GROUP BY rd.district_id, rd.a2
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(balance) AS region_raw
  FROM acct_bal
),
top_dist AS (
  SELECT district_name
  FROM dist_stats
  ORDER BY avg_raw DESC NULLS LAST, district_name ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ds.district_name,
       ds.accounts_opened,
       ROUND(ds.avg_raw::numeric, 2) AS avg_balance_1996,
       ROUND(rs.region_raw::numeric, 2) AS region_avg_balance_1996,
       td.district_name AS top_district
FROM dist_stats ds
CROSS JOIN region_stats rs
CROSS JOIN top_dist td
ORDER BY ds.district_name

WITH client_accts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dp.account_id
  FROM disp dp
  WHERE dp.client_id = 3541
),
region_pop AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a3,
         d.a4::bigint AS pop,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.a3 ORDER BY d.a4::bigint DESC) AS pop_rank
  FROM district d
),
top_district AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (rp.a3) rp.a3, rp.a2 AS top_name, rp.pop AS top_pop
  FROM region_pop rp
  ORDER BY rp.a3, rp.pop DESC
),
region_clients AS (
  SELECT d.a3, COUNT(c.client_id) AS client_cnt
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
  GROUP BY d.a3
),
txn AS (
  SELECT t.account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount END), 0) AS income,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount END), 0) AS expense
  FROM trans t
  GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       a.date AS opened_date,
       a.frequency,
       dist.a2 AS district_name,
       dist.a3 AS region,
       CASE WHEN cl.district_id = a.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
       dist.a11 AS avg_salary,
       COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_status,
       COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
       COALESCE(t.txn_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
       COALESCE(t.income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(t.expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(t.income, 0) - COALESCE(t.expense, 0) AS net_balance,
       rc.client_cnt AS region_client_count,
       td.top_name AS most_populous_district,
       td.top_pop AS most_populous_inhabitants,
       rp.pop_rank AS population_rank_in_region
FROM client_accts ca
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ca.account_id
JOIN district dist ON dist.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = 3541
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN txn t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN region_clients rc ON rc.a3 = dist.a3
JOIN top_district td ON td.a3 = dist.a3
JOIN region_pop rp ON rp.district_id = dist.district_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, a.account_id ASC

SELECT d.a2 AS branch_name,
       COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(d.a3)) = 'north moravia'
  AND t.date <= DATE '1998-10-14'
  AND COALESCE(TRIM(t.k_symbol), '') = ''
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND a.date <= DATE '1995-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')

SELECT t.bank,
       t.account,
       COUNT(*) AS payment_count,
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN trans t
  ON t.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.loan_id = 98832
  AND l.date = DATE '1996-01-03'
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date < DATE '1996-01-03'
GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
ORDER BY total_amount DESC

WITH loan_agg AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*)    AS loan_count,
         SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM loan
  GROUP BY account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT c.client_id,
         c.gender,
         c.birth_date,
         cd.type AS card_type,
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cd.issued)::int - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date)::int AS age_at_issue,
         COALESCE(la.loan_count, 0)   AS loan_count,
         COALESCE(la.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount,
         d.a2  AS district_name,
         d.a11 AS avg_salary
  FROM card cd
  JOIN disp dp     ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id
  JOIN client c    ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  JOIN district d  ON d.district_id = c.district_id
  LEFT JOIN loan_agg la ON la.account_id = dp.account_id
  WHERE cd.issued >= DATE '1994-01-01'
    AND cd.issued <  DATE '1995-01-01'
)
SELECT client_id,
       gender,
       birth_date,
       card_type,
       age_at_issue,
       loan_count,
       total_amount,
       CASE
         WHEN loan_count >= 1 AND age_at_issue < 30  THEN 'Young borrower'
         WHEN loan_count >= 1 AND age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
         ELSE 'Non-borrower'
       END AS borrower_classification,
       district_name,
       avg_salary,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY age_at_issue DESC) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM base
ORDER BY client_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
         CASE
           WHEN t.k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN t.amount
           WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SANKC UROK' THEN -t.amount
           ELSE 0
         END), 0) AS net_interest
FROM trans t
WHERE t.account_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
        FROM disp d
        WHERE d.client_id = 2823
      )
  AND t.date >= DATE '1998-01-01'
  AND t.date <= DATE '1998-12-31'

WITH qualifying_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
    AND a.date >= DATE '1997-01-01'
    AND a.date <  DATE '1998-01-01'
    AND CAST(d.a4 AS bigint) >= 100000
),
qualifying_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM qualifying_accounts
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying_accounts) AS total_accounts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying_districts) AS district_count,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.a11)::numeric, 2)
     FROM district d
     JOIN qualifying_districts qd ON qd.district_id = d.district_id) AS avg_salary

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  WHERE l.duration > 24
    AND a.date < DATE '1997-01-01'
),
qualifying_districts AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.a3 AS region, d.a4::bigint AS population
  FROM district d
  WHERE d.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM qualifying)
),
region_districts AS (
  SELECT region,
         COUNT(*) AS district_count,
         SUM(population) AS total_population
  FROM qualifying_districts
  GROUP BY region
),
region_accounts AS (
  SELECT d.a3 AS region,
         COUNT(DISTINCT q.account_id) AS account_count
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = q.district_id
  GROUP BY d.a3
)
SELECT rd.region,
       rd.district_count,
       rd.total_population,
       ra.account_count
FROM region_districts rd
JOIN region_accounts ra ON ra.region = rd.region
ORDER BY rd.total_population DESC, rd.region ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.a11), 2) AS avg_salary
FROM district d
WHERE d.district_id IN (
    SELECT c.district_id
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.a11)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary
FROM district d
WHERE d.district_id IN (
    SELECT a.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date < DATE '1930-01-01'
)

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
trans_totals AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ'  THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM trans t
    JOIN gold_accounts g ON g.account_id = t.account_id
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
    SELECT l.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan l
    JOIN gold_accounts g ON g.account_id = l.account_id
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
counterparty_counts AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank || '|' || t.account::text) AS external_counterparties
    FROM trans t
    JOIN gold_accounts g ON g.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND t.bank <> ''
      AND t.account IS NOT NULL
      AND t.account <> 0
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
base AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           di.a2 AS district_name,
           di.a3 AS region,
           COALESCE(tt.total_received, 0)          AS total_received,
           COALESCE(tt.total_withdrawn, 0)         AS total_withdrawn,
           COALESCE(lc.loan_count, 0)              AS loan_count,
           COALESCE(cc.external_counterparties, 0) AS external_counterparties
    FROM gold_accounts g
    JOIN account a       ON a.account_id = g.account_id
    JOIN district di     ON di.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN trans_totals tt       ON tt.account_id = g.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_counts lc        ON lc.account_id = g.account_id
    LEFT JOIN counterparty_counts cc ON cc.account_id = g.account_id
)
SELECT account_id,
       district_name,
       region,
       total_received,
       total_withdrawn,
       loan_count,
       external_counterparties,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC) AS rank
FROM base
ORDER BY rank, account_id

WITH female_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.amount,
        l.duration,
        l.payments,
        l.status,
        c.client_id,
        c.birth_date,
        a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
top_loans AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT fl.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fl.amount DESC) AS rnk
        FROM female_loans fl
    ) ranked
    WHERE rnk <= 3
),
region_loans AS (
    SELECT d.a3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.a3
),
region_salary AS (
    SELECT a3 AS region, AVG(a11) AS avg_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY a3
),
trans_stats AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount END), 0) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    tl.client_id,
    tl.amount AS loan_amount,
    tl.duration AS duration_months,
    ROUND((tl.payments::numeric * tl.duration), 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND((tl.payments::numeric * tl.duration - tl.amount), 2) AS interest_paid,
    tl.status AS loan_status,
    d.a2 AS district_name,
    d.a3 AS region,
    COALESCE(ts.trans_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ts.total_deposits, 0)::numeric, 2) AS total_deposits,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(ts.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * tl.amount THEN 'High Income'
        WHEN COALESCE(ts.total_deposits, 0) > tl.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
        ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category,
    rl.loan_count AS region_loan_count,
    ROUND(rs.avg_salary::numeric, 2) AS region_avg_salary,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', tl.birth_date))::int AS age
FROM top_loans tl
JOIN district d ON tl.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN trans_stats ts ON ts.account_id = tl.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_loans rl ON rl.region = d.a3
LEFT JOIN region_salary rs ON rs.region = d.a3
ORDER BY tl.amount DESC

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.a11), 2) AS avg_district_salary
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.amount < 100000
      AND l.status = 'C'
) s
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = s.district_id

WITH cohort_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CASE
            WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) >= 1980 THEN 'young'
            WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) <= 1919 THEN 'old'
        END AS cohort,
        a.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) >= 1980
       OR EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) <= 1919
)
SELECT
    cd.cohort,
    ROUND(AVG(di.a11)) AS avg_salary
FROM cohort_districts cd
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = cd.district_id
GROUP BY cd.cohort
ORDER BY CASE cd.cohort WHEN 'young' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

SELECT ROUND(
         (r1.fastestlapspeed::numeric - r2.fastestlapspeed::numeric)
         / r2.fastestlapspeed::numeric * 100,
         2) AS percentage_higher
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r1 ON r1.driverid = d.driverid AND r1.raceid = 853
JOIN results r2 ON r2.driverid = d.driverid AND r2.raceid = 854
WHERE d.forename = 'Paul'
  AND d.surname ILIKE 'di Resta'

SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.positionorder <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
         2
       ) AS non_victory_percentage
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceid = ra.raceid
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND ra.year >= 2010

WITH tabor_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.a2 = 'Tabor'
      AND a.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
),
owner AS (
    SELECT di.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
    FROM disp di
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = di.client_id
    WHERE di.type = 'OWNER'
),
card_cnt AS (
    SELECT di.account_id, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM card cd
    JOIN disp di ON di.disp_id = cd.disp_id
    WHERE cd.issued <= DATE '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY di.account_id
),
loan_info AS (
    SELECT l.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS n,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b_cnt,
           SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS run_cnt
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
trans_1997 AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS tx_cnt,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount END), 0) AS money_in,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN t.amount END), 0) AS money_out,
           MAX(t.balance) AS peak
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date >= DATE '1997-01-01'
      AND t.date <= DATE '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
profile AS (
    SELECT ta.account_id,
           ta.opened_date,
           o.gender,
           CAST(date_part('year', age(DATE '1996-12-31', o.birth_date)) AS int) AS age,
           COALESCE(cc.n, 0) AS card_count,
           COALESCE(li.n, 0) AS loan_count,
           CASE
               WHEN COALESCE(li.n, 0) = 0 THEN 'no loan'
               WHEN COALESCE(li.b_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 'defaulted'
               WHEN COALESCE(li.run_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 'repaying'
               ELSE 'paid off'
           END AS loan_status,
           COALESCE(tr.tx_cnt, 0) AS tx_count,
           COALESCE(tr.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
           COALESCE(tr.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
           COALESCE(tr.peak, 0) AS peak_balance
    FROM tabor_accounts ta
    LEFT JOIN owner o ON o.account_id = ta.account_id
    LEFT JOIN card_cnt cc ON cc.account_id = ta.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_info li ON li.account_id = ta.account_id
    LEFT JOIN trans_1997 tr ON tr.account_id = ta.account_id
)
SELECT account_id,
       opened_date,
       gender,
       age,
       card_count,
       loan_count,
       loan_status,
       tx_count,
       money_in,
       money_out,
       peak_balance,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS peak_rank
FROM profile
ORDER BY peak_rank, account_id

WITH classic_owners AS (

outgoing AS (

q1times AS (

SELECT p.admission,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patient_count
FROM patient p

      SELECT l.id
      FROM laboratory l
      WHERE l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
        AND CAST(l.rnp AS numeric) > 16
  )
GROUP BY p.admission

SELECT MAX(CAST(l.rnp AS numeric)) AS max_rnp
FROM laboratory l
JOIN patient p ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.admission = '-'
  AND l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM patient p
WHERE p.admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM laboratory l1
        WHERE l1.id = p.id
          AND (l1.hct <= 29 OR l1.hct >= 52)
      )

        SELECT 1
        FROM laboratory l2
        WHERE l2.id = p.id
          AND l2.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
          AND l2.rnp::numeric > 16
      )

SELECT p.sex,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patient_count
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.alb < 3.5
  AND p.sex IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.sex

SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
         / COUNT(*),
         1) AS percentage
FROM patient
WHERE diagnosis ILIKE 'psoriatic arthritis'
   OR diagnosis ILIKE 'PsA'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.tp - 8.5)::numeric, 3) AS avg_tp_deviation
FROM laboratory l
JOIN patient p
  ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.sex = 'F'
  AND l.tp > 8.5
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM examination e
    WHERE e.id = l.id
      AND (e.diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
           OR e.diagnosis ILIKE '%systemic lupus erythematosus%')
  )

WITH target AS (
  SELECT p.id
  FROM patient p
  WHERE (
    SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT x ORDER BY x)
    FROM unnest(string_to_array(upper(replace(p.diagnosis, ' ', '')), ',')) AS x
  ) = ARRAY['RA', 'SJS']
),
normal AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.id
  FROM laboratory l
  JOIN target t ON t.id = l.id
  WHERE l.plt > 100 AND l.plt < 400
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM target t
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM normal n WHERE n.id = t.id)) AS patients_with_normal_platelet,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM target t
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM normal n WHERE n.id = t.id)) AS patients_never_normal_platelet

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.sex = 'F') AS women,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.sex = 'M') AS men
FROM patient p
WHERE p.id IN (
  SELECT l.id
  FROM laboratory l
  WHERE l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
    AND CAST(l.rnp AS numeric) > 32
)

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date)::int - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday)::int) AS youngest_age
FROM laboratory l
JOIN patient p ON p.id = l.id
WHERE l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND l.rnp::int >= 64
  AND l.id IN (SELECT e.id FROM examination e WHERE e.thrombosis > 0)

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday)::int) AS average_age_1999
FROM patient p
WHERE p.id IN (
    SELECT l.id
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l."U-PRO" IN ('3+', '4+')
       OR (CASE
             WHEN l."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN l."U-PRO"::numeric >= 300
             ELSE false
           END)
)

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM laboratory l
   JOIN patient p ON l.id = p.id
   WHERE p.diagnosis ILIKE '%psoriatic%') AS total_lab_tests,
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM patient p
   WHERE p.diagnosis ILIKE '%psoriatic%'
     AND NOT EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM laboratory l
       WHERE l.id = p.id
     )) AS patients_without_lab_tests

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS patient_count
FROM examination
WHERE thrombosis > 0
  AND "Examination Date" BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.id
    FROM patient p
    JOIN examination e ON e.id = p.id
    WHERE p.sex = 'F'
),
rnp_per_patient AS (
    SELECT l.id,
           MAX(
             CASE
               WHEN trim(l.rnp) ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN
                 CASE WHEN trim(l.rnp)::numeric > 64 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               ELSE 0
             END
           ) AS elevated
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.rnp IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(l.rnp) <> ''
    GROUP BY l.id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(r.elevated) / COUNT(*), 2) AS elevated_rnp_percentage
FROM cohort c
JOIN rnp_per_patient r ON r.id = c.id

SELECT p.sex,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patient_count
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.date BETWEEN '1994-01-01' AND '1994-12-31'
  AND l.got < 60
  AND p.sex IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.sex

WITH first_exam AS (
    SELECT id, MIN("Examination Date") AS first_exam_date
    FROM examination
    GROUP BY id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(fe.first_exam_date - p."First Date")) AS avg_delay_days
FROM patient p
JOIN first_exam fe ON fe.id = p.id
WHERE p.admission LIKE '%+%'

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.sex = 'F' THEN p.id END)
  - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.sex = 'M' THEN p.id END) AS result
FROM patient p
WHERE p.diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND p.id IN (
    SELECT l.id
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.un < 30
  )

SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(TRIM(diagnosis)) = 'SLE')
         / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
         2
       ) AS percentage
FROM examination
WHERE thrombosis > 0

WITH sle_patients AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM patient
    WHERE diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
),
thrombotic_episodes AS (
    SELECT e.symptoms
    FROM examination e
    JOIN sle_patients p ON p.id = e.id
    WHERE e.thrombosis > 0
      AND e.symptoms IS NOT NULL
),
split_symptoms AS (
    SELECT trim(s) AS symptom
    FROM thrombotic_episodes,
         unnest(string_to_array(symptoms, ',')) AS s
)
SELECT symptom
FROM split_symptoms
WHERE symptom <> ''
GROUP BY symptom
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, symptom ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT
       p.id,
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', p.birthday))::int AS age
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l
  ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.ldh > 600
  AND l.ldh < 800
  AND CAST(SUBSTRING(l."U-PRO" FROM '[0-9]+\.?[0-9]*') AS numeric) >= 300

WITH rnp_vals AS (
  SELECT p.id, l.rnp::numeric AS rnp_level
  FROM patient p
  JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p."First Date") = 1991
    AND l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
)
SELECT DISTINCT id, rnp_level AS anti_rnp_level
FROM rnp_vals
WHERE rnp_level = (SELECT MAX(rnp_level) FROM rnp_vals)

SELECT
  p.sex,
  COUNT(h.id) AS patients_with_abnormal_creatinine,
  COUNT(*) AS total_patients,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(h.id) / COUNT(*), 1) AS percentage_abnormal
FROM patient p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT id
  FROM laboratory
  WHERE cre >= 1.5
) h ON h.id = p.id
WHERE p.sex IN ('M', 'F')
GROUP BY p.sex

WITH joined AS (
  SELECT p.admission, l.id, l."T-CHO"
  FROM laboratory l
  JOIN patient p ON p.id = l.id
  WHERE l."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL
    AND p.admission IN ('+', '-')
),
group_max AS (
  SELECT admission, MAX("T-CHO") AS max_tcho
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY admission
)
SELECT DISTINCT j.admission, j.id, j."T-CHO"
FROM joined j
JOIN group_max g
  ON j.admission = g.admission
 AND j."T-CHO" = g.max_tcho
ORDER BY j.admission, j.id

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.admission = '+') AS admitted_patients,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.admission = '-') AS outpatient_patients
FROM patient p
WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND p.id IN (
    SELECT l.id
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
      AND CAST(l."U-PRO" AS numeric) >= 30
  )

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM patient p
WHERE p.admission = '+'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.id = p.id
      AND l.alp >= 300
  )

WITH latest_sample AS (
  SELECT id, MAX(date) AS last_date
  FROM laboratory
  GROUP BY id
),
latest_sc170 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, sc170

  WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL

)

FROM latest_sample ls

WHERE ls.last_date > DATE '1997-01-01'

SELECT AVG(hct) AS avg_hct

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS female_patient_count

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patient_count

      )

SELECT
  CASE p.sex

GROUP BY p.sex

SELECT MAX(CAST(rnp AS numeric)) AS max_anti_rnp

WITH high_got AS (

SELECT id, date, rnp

SELECT COUNT(*) AS admitted_female_p_pattern_count
FROM patient p

  )

WITH no_sex AS (
  SELECT id

),
lab_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.id
  FROM laboratory l
  JOIN no_sex n ON n.id = l.id

elevated_bil_patients AS (

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_patients) AS patients_with_lab_results,

SELECT
  CASE p.admission

WHERE p.admission IN ('+', '-')

WITH first_lab AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, got, rnp

  ORDER BY id, date ASC
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM first_lab f
JOIN patient p ON p.id = f.id
WHERE f.got < 60
  AND f.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
  AND f.rnp::numeric > 10

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.sex
  FROM patient p
  WHERE p.admission = '-'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM laboratory l
      WHERE l.id = p.id
        AND l.hgb < 10
    )
),
rnp_vals AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.sex, CAST(l.rnp AS numeric) AS rnp_level
  FROM cohort c

  WHERE l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
),
max_rnp AS (
  SELECT MAX(rnp_level) AS max_level
  FROM rnp_vals
)
SELECT DISTINCT r.id, r.sex, r.rnp_level

JOIN max_rnp m ON r.rnp_level = m.max_level

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS eligible_patient_count

            ELSE FALSE
          END, FALSE)
      )

WITH ranked_proteinuria AS (
    SELECT
        l.id,
        l.date,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.id ORDER BY l.date DESC) AS rn
    FROM laboratory l

)
SELECT
    p.id,
    p.sex,
    r.date,
    r."U-PRO"
FROM ranked_proteinuria r
JOIN patient p ON p.id = r.id
WHERE r.rn = 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.id
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.admission = '-'

  AND l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
  AND CAST(l.rnp AS numeric) > 4

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS female_patient_count
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.sex = 'F'
  AND l.pt < 14
  AND (CASE
         WHEN l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST(l.rnp AS numeric)
       END) >= 16

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS patient_count
FROM laboratory l
JOIN examination e
  ON e.id = l.id
WHERE CASE
        WHEN l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN l.rnp::numeric
      END > 0
  AND e.thrombosis = 0

WITH rnp_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.id
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
      AND CAST(l.rnp AS numeric) >= 16
),
liver AS (
    SELECT l.id,
           MAX(l.gpt) AS max_gpt,
           MAX(CASE WHEN l.gpt < 60 THEN l.gpt END) AS max_normal_gpt

SELECT p.birthday

ORDER BY lv.max_normal_gpt DESC, lv.id ASC

SELECT
  date_part('year', age(l.date, p.birthday))::int AS age,

WHERE p.admission = '+'
  AND l.dna ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
ORDER BY l.dna::numeric DESC, l.date ASC

SELECT p.id, p.sex
FROM patient p

ORDER BY p.sex, p.id

WITH latest_igg AS (

  ORDER BY id, date DESC
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM patient p
JOIN latest_igg l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.admission = '-'
  AND l.igg >= 2000

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT p.id,
         CASE WHEN p.admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
              ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
         END AS care_setting
  FROM patient p
  WHERE p.sex = 'F'

),
flagged AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.id

          ELSE false
        END
)
SELECT c.care_setting,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.id IS NOT NULL) AS patients_with_elevated_anti_rnp,

GROUP BY c.care_setting
ORDER BY c.care_setting

WITH sle_dna AS (
  SELECT p.id,
         p.diagnosis,
         l.dna,
         CAST(l.dna AS double precision) AS dna_num
  FROM patient p
  JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
  WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE'
    AND l.dna ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
),
max_dna AS (
  SELECT MAX(dna_num) AS max_val
  FROM sle_dna
)
SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.diagnosis, s.dna
FROM sle_dna s
JOIN max_dna m ON s.dna_num = m.max_val

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT l.id,
         l.rnp,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.id ORDER BY l.date DESC) AS rn
  FROM laboratory l
),
strong_latest AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.sex

)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
     - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sex = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS result
FROM strong_latest

WITH latest_igg AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.id) l.id, l.igg

  WHERE l.igg IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY l.id, l.date DESC
)
SELECT
  CASE p.admission

  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE li.igg > 900 AND li.igg < 2000) / COUNT(*),

  ) AS normal_igg_percentage
FROM patient p
LEFT JOIN latest_igg li ON li.id = p.id
WHERE p.admission IN ('+', '-')
GROUP BY p.admission
ORDER BY p.admission DESC

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    l.id,
    l.rnp,
    l.cpk,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.id ORDER BY l.date DESC) AS rn
  FROM laboratory l
  JOIN patient p ON p.id = l.id

    AND l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') AS inpatients,

  ) AS inpatient_percentage

SELECT p.sex, COUNT(*) AS patient_count

WHERE NOT EXISTS (

      )

GROUP BY p.sex

SELECT COUNT(*)

WHERE sex = 'F'

SELECT p.id, p.sex, p.birthday

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::numeric, 1) AS avg_acl_igm

SELECT diagnosis

WHERE admission = '+'

  AND birthday IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY birthday ASC, id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM patient
WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%psoriatic%'

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.sex = 'M') AS male_patients,

FROM patient p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.id = p.id
      AND l.gpt >= 60
)

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT e.id, e."Examination Date", e.symptoms
  FROM examination e
  WHERE e.diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
    AND e.diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SLE susp%'
    AND e.symptoms IS NOT NULL
    AND e.symptoms <> ''
),
target_patient AS (

SELECT q.symptoms, tp.diagnosis

SELECT p.sex, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.id = p.id
)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(e."aCL IgM")::numeric, 2) AS avg_acl_igm

JOIN patient p ON p.id = e.id
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(p.diagnosis)) = 'SJS'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patient_count
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.admission = '-'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(l.rnp)) IN ('negative', '0')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM patient p
JOIN examination e ON e.id = p.id
WHERE p.sex = 'F'
  AND e.diagnosis = 'SjS'

SELECT p.admission,
       COUNT(*) AS patient_count,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', p.birthday)))::numeric, 1) AS avg_age
FROM patient p
WHERE p.admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM laboratory l
      WHERE l.id = p.id
        AND l.rbc < 3.5
  )
GROUP BY p.admission

SELECT p.id
FROM patient p
WHERE p.admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM laboratory l
        WHERE l.id = p.id
          AND (l.rbc <= 3.5 OR l.rbc >= 6.0)
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM laboratory l
        WHERE l.id = p.id
          AND CASE
                WHEN l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN l.rnp::numeric
                ELSE 0
              END > 0
      )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS patient_count
FROM laboratory l
WHERE l.sm IN ('negative', '0')
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM laboratory l2
        WHERE l2.id = l.id
          AND l2."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
          AND CAST(l2."U-PRO" AS numeric) >= 30
      )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM examination e
        WHERE e.id = l.id
          AND e.thrombosis > 0
      )

SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
         1
       ) AS women_percentage
FROM patient p
WHERE p.birthday BETWEEN '1936-01-01' AND '1956-12-31'
  AND p.sex IN ('F', 'M')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM laboratory l
        WHERE l.id = p.id
          AND l.cpk >= 250
      )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS female_patient_count
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.sex = 'F'
  AND l.wbc > 3.5
  AND l.wbc < 9.0
  AND (l.fg <= 150 OR l.fg >= 450)
  AND (CASE WHEN l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
            THEN CAST(l.rnp AS numeric)
       END) > 15

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT p.id,
         date_part('year', age(DATE '2026-10-09', p.birthday)) AS age_years
  FROM patient p
  WHERE p.birthday IS NOT NULL
    AND date_part('year', age(DATE '2026-10-09', p.birthday)) < 70
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM laboratory l
      WHERE l.id = p.id
        AND CASE WHEN l.rnp ~ '^\s*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\s*$'
                 THEN l.rnp::numeric END >= 64
    )
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(age_years)::numeric, 1) AS average_age
FROM eligible

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(o.cnt, 0))::numeric, 4) AS avg_oxygen_per_molecule
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
) m
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'o'
    GROUP BY molecule_id
) o ON m.molecule_id = o.molecule_id

SELECT AVG(t.single_bond_count) AS avg_single_bonds_per_molecule
FROM (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS single_bond_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '-'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) t

WITH element_counts AS (
  SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM atom a
  JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '-'
  GROUP BY a.element
)
SELECT element
FROM element_counts
WHERE cnt = (SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM element_counts)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS patient_count
FROM laboratory l
JOIN patient p
  ON p.id = l.id
WHERE l.date BETWEEN DATE '1981-01-01' AND DATE '1986-12-31'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(l.date, p.birthday)) < 50
  AND l.plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  AND l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(l."U-PRO") NOT IN ('-', '0', '')

SELECT b.bond_type,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom AS a
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
       OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
)

SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
           WHERE NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1
             FROM atom a
             WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
               AND LOWER(a.element) = 'f'
           )
         ) / COUNT(*),
         2
       ) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'i' THEN a.atom_id END) AS iodine_atoms,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 's' THEN a.atom_id END) AS sulfur_atoms
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id IN (
  SELECT c.atom_id
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
  UNION
  SELECT c.atom_id2
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
)

SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n')
   OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p')

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = '#'
      )
  AND molecule_id IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE LOWER(element) IN ('p', 'br')
      )

SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(a.element) = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
         4
       ) AS chlorine_percentage
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS hydrogen_fraction,
       m.label
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
          AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS multiple_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR041_10'

WITH multi_type AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type IS DISTINCT FROM '-'
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN mt.molecule_id IS NULL THEN 'all_single_bonds' ELSE 'other' END AS group_type,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1
           WHEN m.label = '-' THEN -1
           ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN multi_type mt ON mt.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
GROUP BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS carbon_double_bond_pairs
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a1.element = 'c'
  AND a2.element = 'c'
  AND b.bond_type = '='
  AND m.label = '+'
  AND c.atom_id < c.atom_id2

SELECT b.bond_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a1.element = 'c'
  AND a2.element = 'c'
GROUP BY b.bond_type

WITH plus_atoms AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
    FROM atom a
    JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
),
bonded_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id FROM connected
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected
),
bonded_counts AS (
    SELECT p.element, COUNT(*) AS bonded_cnt
    FROM plus_atoms p
    WHERE p.atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM bonded_atoms)
    GROUP BY p.element
),
top_elements AS (
    SELECT element
    FROM bonded_counts
    WHERE bonded_cnt = (SELECT MAX(bonded_cnt) FROM bonded_counts)
),
total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM plus_atoms
)
SELECT t.element,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(p.atom_id) / (SELECT n FROM total), 2) AS percentage
FROM top_elements t
JOIN plus_atoms p ON p.element = t.element
GROUP BY t.element

SELECT COUNT(*) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM (
    SELECT c.atom_id2 AS bonded_atom
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    WHERE a.element = 'cl'
    UNION
    SELECT c.atom_id AS bonded_atom
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
    WHERE a.element = 'cl'
) AS bonded

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.atom_id2) AS count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom s ON c.atom_id = s.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON s.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE s.element = 's'
  AND m.label = '+'

WITH exclusive_elements AS (
    SELECT element
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY element
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND a.element IN (SELECT element FROM exclusive_elements)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n.atom_id) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM (
    SELECT c.atom_id2 AS atom_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    WHERE a.element = 'cl'
    UNION
    SELECT c.atom_id AS atom_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
    WHERE a.element = 'cl'
) n

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS carcinogenic_percent,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS non_carcinogenic_percent
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (
  SELECT b.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM atom a
WHERE a.element = 'n'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom a2
    WHERE a2.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
      AND a2.element = 'n'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM connected c
        JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
        WHERE (c.atom_id = a2.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id)
          AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
      )
  )

WITH y_molecule AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE LOWER(element) = 'y'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS hydrogen_bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM y_molecule)
  AND (LOWER(a1.element) = 'h' OR LOWER(a2.element) = 'h')

SELECT ROUND(
         CAST(COUNT(c.atom_id) AS NUMERIC) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id),
         2
       ) AS avg_bonds_per_atom
FROM atom a
LEFT JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'

SELECT a2.element,
       COUNT(*) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1   ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2   ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond b    ON c.bond_id  = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
  AND a1.element = 'c'
GROUP BY a2.element

WITH element_mols AS (
    SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS n_molecules
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY element
),
rare_atoms AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, a.molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    JOIN element_mols em ON em.element = a.element
    WHERE em.n_molecules = 1
),
bond_ends AS (
    SELECT bond_id, atom_id AS aid FROM connected
    UNION ALL
    SELECT bond_id, atom_id2 AS aid FROM connected
)
SELECT m.molecule_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT be.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM molecule m
JOIN rare_atoms r ON r.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond_ends be ON be.aid = r.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY m.molecule_id

SELECT b.bond_type AS bond_kind,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT LEAST(a1.element, a2.element) || '-' || GREATEST(a1.element, a2.element)) AS element_pair_count,
       m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY bond_count DESC, bond_kind ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a.element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li')
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3

WITH carbon_mols AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'c'
),
atom_counts AS (
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS n_atoms,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS n_carbon,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS n_chlorine
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS n_bonds,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS n_multiple,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM connected c
        JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
        JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
        WHERE c.bond_id = b.bond_id
          AND (a1.element = 'c' OR a2.element = 'c')
      )
    ) AS n_carbon_bonds
  FROM bond b
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
inventory AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    mo.label,
    COALESCE(ac.n_atoms, 0) AS n_atoms,
    COALESCE(bc.n_bonds, 0) AS n_bonds,
    COALESCE(ac.n_carbon, 0) AS n_carbon,
    COALESCE(ac.n_chlorine, 0) AS n_chlorine,
    COALESCE(bc.n_carbon_bonds, 0) AS n_carbon_bonds,
    COALESCE(bc.n_multiple, 0) AS n_multiple
  FROM carbon_mols m
  JOIN molecule mo ON mo.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN atom_counts ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
)
SELECT
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (
    ORDER BY n_carbon_bonds DESC, n_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC
  ) AS rank,
  molecule_id,
  label,
  n_atoms,
  n_bonds,
  n_carbon,
  n_chlorine,
  n_carbon_bonds,
  n_multiple
FROM inventory
ORDER BY rank, molecule_id

SELECT a.element,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, a.element ASC

WITH atom_bonds AS (
  SELECT c.atom_id AS atom_id, b.bond_type AS bond_type
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.atom_id2 AS atom_id, b.bond_type AS bond_type
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
),
single_only AS (
  SELECT atom_id
  FROM atom_bonds
  GROUP BY atom_id
  HAVING bool_and(bond_type = '-')
)
SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN single_only s ON s.atom_id = a.atom_id
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element

SELECT a.element,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                 SELECT 1
                 FROM connected c
                 WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
               ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element
